text:
# SEO and GEO audit: Atlas (Remix, 10 files)

I read every tracked file. Findings are ordered by severity.

## High

1. **`public/robots.txt:5-6` blocks Bingbot site-wide.**
   - Bing's index feeds ChatGPT search and Copilot, and Bing is also a search engine in its own right. `geo.config.json:1` says `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`, so this rule contradicts your stated policy.
   - **Fix:** delete the Bingbot block.

2. **`public/robots.txt` doesn't match the training-crawler policy.**
   - `geo.config.json:1` says `trainingCrawlers: "block"`. Only `GPTBot` is blocked (lines 8-9).
   - `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `Bytespider`, `Applebot-Extended` and `meta-externalagent` are all allowed by the `*` rule.
   - **Fix:** add a `Disallow: /` group for each of those user-agents.
   - **Fix:** add explicit `Allow: /` groups for the AI search and retrieval bots: `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Claude-User`. This makes the policy visible and durable.

3. **`app/routes/changelog.tsx:4-6` renders its content only on the client.**
   - Entries load in `useEffect` from `/api/changelog`, so server HTML contains an empty `<ul>`.
   - Most AI crawlers don't execute JS, so they see no content. Googlebot may see it late.
   - **Fix:** use a Remix `loader` and `useLoaderData()` so the entries are server-rendered.
   - Also, no `/api/changelog` route exists in the repo, so the fetch would 404 here.

## Medium

4. **`app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` has no `meta` export.**
   - The page has no title, description or canonical. It inherits only the root fallback.
   - **Fix:** add `meta` like the other routes.
   - The copy is "Talk to us for a quote". It states no plans or prices, so there is nothing for an AI answer to quote. Add concrete plan names, prices and what each includes.

5. **`app/root.tsx:2` sets a generic title and description, and the root has no canonical.**
   - The title is just "Atlas", and the description is not unique.
   - Remix route `meta` replaces the parent's `meta` instead of merging with it. Any route without its own `meta` (currently `pricing`) falls back to this one.
   - **Fix:** make the root fallback descriptive, and generate a canonical per route.

6. **`app/routes/_index.tsx:9` navigates with a click-handler `<div>`.**
   - "See all features" is a `<div onClick={navigate}>`, not a link. Crawlers won't follow it, and it isn't keyboard or screen-reader accessible.
   - **Fix:** use `<Link to="/features">`.
   - `/features` is also missing from the root nav (`app/root.tsx:7`), which links only to Pricing and Changelog.
   - **Fix:** add Features, and a Home link, to the nav.

7. **`app/routes/_index.tsx:8` makes a vague claim: "Integrates with all the tools you already use."**
   - AI engines favor specific, extractable facts.
   - **Fix:** name the integrations, for example Jira, Linear and Slack, if that is accurate.
   - `app/routes/features.tsx:2` is similarly thin: a single sentence. Expand it with one section per feature, using `h2` headings.

8. **There is no structured data anywhere.**
   - **Fix:** add JSON-LD `Organization` and `WebSite` on the root.
   - **Fix:** add `SoftwareApplication` with `offers` on pricing.
   - **Fix:** add `FAQPage` or `Article` where relevant.
   - **Fix:** put the JSON-LD in each route's `meta`, using `{ "script:ld+json": {...} }`.

## Low

9. **`public/robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line.**
   - **Fix:** add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`.

10. **`public/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no `<lastmod>` on any URL.**
    - **Fix:** add `<lastmod>`, especially for the changelog.

11. **There are no Open Graph or Twitter card tags in any route or the root.**
    - **Fix:** add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url` and `twitter:card`.

12. **There is no `llms.txt` in `public/`.** It is optional and low-impact. Adding one would give AI tools a concise site summary.

13. **`app/root.tsx:5-6` has no `<meta charset>` or `<meta name="viewport">` in `<head>`.**
    - Mobile-friendliness is a ranking factor.
    - **Fix:** add both to the head.

## Correct as-is
- `app/routes/dashboard.tsx:1` is `noindex`, is disallowed in robots.txt, and is absent from the sitemap. Those three are consistent.
- Canonicals on `_index`, `features` and `changelog` use the right origin.
- `<html lang="en">` is set, and every page has a single `h1`.

I haven't changed anything. I can apply fixes 1-3, 4 and 6 now if you want.
